data.name: BingSearchResults_Name
data.value: Bing search results in Windows search

data.name: BingSearchResults_Description
data.value: Toggles whether Bing web results appear in the Start and Search experience for the current user.

data.name: BingSearchResults_SwitchDescription
data.value: When on, Windows search includes Bing web results. When off, only local results are shown.

data.name: WipeFreeSpace_Description
data.value: Overwrites free space on the selected drive so that deleted files can no longer be recovered with forensic tools.
